w: At 5.55 pm Swamishri departed from Navsari and arrived Sankari at 7.00 pm.

At 3.30 p.m., a seminar on ‘Integration of Philosophy in Life' was held in Madras University. The seminar was sponsored by the BAPS and University of Madras. Renowned scholars like Dr Narsimhachari, Dr K.K.A. Venkatachari, Pujya Viveksagar Swami, Pujya Shrutiprakash Swami and Prof. Janak Dave addressed an audience of 27 Sanskrit Scholars. In conclusion, Swamishri honored the pundits and addressed the assembly.
23 Decembner 2003 (V.S. 2060, Maghar vad 30) Tuesday, Chennai Swamishri visited the historic Mahabalipuram mandir.

Pramukh Swami Maharaj was reading letters. Meanwhile a devotee phoned from America. He said, "When my son was small, he did his puja and prayers and everything, but for the last year and a half he has given up his puja. His mother wishes that he does puja. Through his mother's persuasion, it has now sunk in. So from today he has started doing puja."
Swamishri said, "Give him the phone."

Speaking with the son, Swamishri said, "You had good values from childhood. You also did puja. Now that understanding has come, do your puja sincerely. Keep your life pure and clean. The good thought that has come is the fruit of devotion. We bless you that since you have set out on the right path, you will get strength and have peace."

A youth phoned. His friend had been taken away by naga babas (naked ascetics). After a search he was found, but after coming home he stays naked, smokes bidis and keeps making postures as if doing austerities.

Speaking with that youth, Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "You have left the group and come back, so now leave all those thoughts behind and worship God; in that lies your good. Do what pleases your mother and father, and do as they say."

Today, after finishing breakfast, as Mahant Swami Maharaj was going towards his room, on the way youths asked, "Swami! You stayed here five days and gave us great joy of darshan and association. But today you will leave. So what should we do to have such joy of darshan and association every day?"
"Daily satsang." Giving a beautiful and precise answer, Swamishri moved on.

Today Mahant Swami Maharaj was travelling from Navsari via Ukai towards Dhulia. Along with the speed of the car, Swamishri's letter work was also going at full pace. Swamishri kept dictating answers to the questions asked one after another by the letter attendant. In that series came a devotee's question: "Seeing the toilet in my house, a Brahmin said that the toilet should not be in the north east direction. So please guide me on which direction to build the toilet."
What a level of religious guru, and what a level of question! It was a matter that would make anyone's face twist. But Swamishri calmly gave the solution: "If there is no problem, keep it as it is."
How many religious gurus in the world would go so deep into the questions of their followers!

A bus was going in front of Mahant Swami Maharaj's car as it travelled towards Dhulia. In its last seat sat two small children in school uniform. One could guess they were in the sixth or seventh standard. Seeing Swamishri through the large rear window of the bus, both of them knelt on the seat and kept looking straight at Swamishri.

Swamishri too kept them in his gaze. He too began to wave his right hand in response to the children. Because of the setting sun, there was a reflection from the bus window. So one child put his face out of the window and gazed at Swamishri. Swamishri now began to bless them by waving both hands.
Seeing this, the sadhus asked, "Since your glance fell on them, they have been liberated, haven't they?"
"Yes," Swamishri said. "Whoever has his darshan and touch will cross the ocean of worldly life..." The truth of these words of Shriji was in his yes.
At this time (21, 22 and 23 December) a parayan was going on in Sarangpur on the occasion of the passing away of Haribhai Mandaliya. His story is one that inspires wonder:

Haribhai, a descendant of Narsinhbhai, the brother of Bhagatji Maharaj, had for some time been having increasing heart problems. His health was declining. The doctors too had said, "These are now the last days."
So Mahant Swami Maharaj was contacted by phone. Hari Kaka requested, "Swami! Now take me to Akshardham... And when Swami and Maharaj come to take me, will you also come with them to take me?"
Swamishri said, "Yes, we will come with Maharaj to take you."
There was also a wedding in his family, so giving his blessings for that too, Swamishri added, "On the 10th day after the wedding we will come with Maharaj to take you."

And exactly that happened! The wedding was completed on 30 November, and on the evening of 10 December Hari Kaka began to say, "Maharaj has come, and Swami is with him too... Bring the arti, I want to perform arti."
Haribhai and the family performed arti. And on 11 November at 6:00 in the morning he passed away to Akshardham.
The one who gave the promise was the guru, and the one who fulfilled it was Shri Hari!!
